For each one, a one line answer and the ids of matching records, plus the records themselves. A record scoped to some code (for example only repos that depend

tools.name: list_upcoming
tools.description: List the dated changes in apiwatch's feed from today forward, soonest first: model retirements, breaking API changes, silent behavior changes and deprecation key dates. Use it to plan migrations. Optionally limit to the next N days (default 90, max 365) or one vendor. Max 50 records.

tools.name: search_changes
tools.description: Search apiwatch's feed of reviewed vendor changes by text: a case-insensitive match on each record's summary, vendor and signatures (the strings to look for in code). Use it when you know a product or feature name but not the exact id. Newest key date first; default 20 results, max 50.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Get one apiwatch record in full, as published: what changes, what to do, the strings to search for, ids it does not cover, where it applies, the vendor source and when it was reviewed. Use an id from another tool's result.

tools.name: list_watched_mcp_servers
tools.description: List the public MCP servers whose tools apiwatch checks every 6 hours (tools/list only, no login, no tool calls), with each one's status (answering, needs a login, not reachable), tool count, last check and last observed change. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_model, list_upcoming, search_changes · Private data: check_model, check_identifiers, list_upcoming, search_changes, get_record · Public sink: list_upcoming.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_model, list_upcoming, search_changes · Private data: check_model, check_identifiers, list_upcoming, search_changes, get_record · Public sink: list_upcoming

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
